known_internal_inconsistencies: Results text: 12 methods on 12 datasets; Methods: 10 studies split into 13 datasets; Supplementary Fig. 1: 10 tools, 35 runs (Scanorama and fastMNN scored on two outputs each, giving 12 method-output combinations).
Fig. 1 caption: 35 additional datasets mapped; Results text: 37 datasets mapped (1,797,714 cells).

core_preprocessing.gene_filter: Cell Ranger Ensembl 84 gene-type filter (33,694 gene IDs)

batch_unit_decision.method: principal component regression (PCexpl) on 50 PCs per study, per candidate covariate
batch_unit_decision.null: 10 random shufflings of the covariate across samples
batch_unit_decision.outcome: Jain_Misharin_2021 and Barbry_Leroy_2020 split by 10x v1/v2; Seibold_2020 split by 10x v2/v3; Banovich_Kropski_2020 not split

hvg.consensus_rule: genes highly variable in all datasets first, then in all but one, and so on, until the target count is reached

exceptions: scVI and scANVI: raw counts only, never scaled
fastMNN: FULL feature set exceeded memory; HVG only
Scanorama and fastMNN: scored on both gene-matrix and embedding outputs

supervision.labels_used: level 3 harmonised labels; level 2 for blood-vessel endothelial, fibroblast lineage, mesothelial and smooth muscle cells

metrics.scaling: each metric min-max scaled to [0,1] across runs
metrics.category_score: mean of metrics in the category

benchmark.ranking_caveat: Order transcribed from the rendered Supplementary Fig. 1; numeric scores are not printed in the paper and must be taken from the HLCA_reproducibility repository before being quoted.

secondary_criterion.name: rare cell type recall and precision per level-3 cluster
secondary_criterion.outcome: Harmony and Seurat RPCA did not separate the rare cell types into distinct clusters (Supplementary Fig. 3b)

final_integration.labels: coarse label set (28 classes listed in Methods) plus unlabeled kept as a class
final_integration.use_of_latent: clustering and visualisation only; gene-level analyses use uncorrected counts

clustering.naming: parent.child, children ordered by size from 0

label_entropy.definition: Shannon entropy, natural log, over cell-type label fractions in a cluster; unlabelled cells excluded; NA if < 20% of cells labelled at that level
label_entropy.threshold_origin: entropy of a hypothetical 75/25 two-label cluster
label_entropy.use: flag cross-study disagreement (33 of 94 clusters) and doublet clusters (6 removed)

donor_entropy.threshold_origin: entropy of a hypothetical cluster with 95% of cells from one donor and 5% spread over all other donors; depends on donor count and must be recomputed per dataset
donor_entropy.use: flag donor-private clusters (14 of 94; IPF fibroblast cluster 5 with donor entropy 0.17 excluded)

marker_selection.test: t-test, one cell type vs all others

covariate_modelling.min_samples_origin: below 40 samples, mean variance explained across covariates correlates negatively with sample count (spurious attribution)
covariate_modelling.model: log(normcount) ~ 1 + age + sex + BMI + smoking + nose + CCF + (1 | dataset)
covariate_modelling.normalisation: edgeR calcNormFactors, then voom with mixed effects
covariate_modelling.ethnicity: excluded from the model because it collapsed the usable sample set

reference_mapping.method: scArches surgery on the scANVI model

label_transfer.uncertainty: u = 1 - weighted proportion of neighbours carrying the transferred label

uncertainty_cutoff.calibration: ROC over 12 mapped datasets with level-3/4 labels; TPR 0.879, FPR 0.495; level-5 labels excluded

disease_signature.genes: top 20 up by log fold change with FDR < 0.05 and mean expression >= 0.1 in the high group
disease_signature.score: mean expression minus a binned random reference set

reference_mapping.dataset_mapping_quality: mean uncertainty per dataset; 27 of 37 datasets judged to map well

cross_dataset_state_clustering.resolution_rule: chosen so that no dataset is isolated in a single cluster

spatial_celltype_cluster_search.selection: highest recall unless precision drops > 33% vs the second-best; take the next cluster if its precision doubles and recall drops <= 20%

bulk_deconvolution.validation: pseudo-bulks from the core, correlation with truth

GSE178360.note: this repository analysed 27,729 cells after its own QC; the HLCA mapped 21,700

GSE262927.note: cross-species mapping is not supported by the paper
